message.content:
This product is ammonium thiosulfate solution, a mineral fertilizer containing nitrogen and sulfur, imported in 1-liter containers.

Chapter 31 covers fertilizers. Heading 3105 covers mineral or chemical fertilizers with two or three of the fertilizing elements nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium, and other fertilizers. Ammonium thiosulfate contains only nitrogen and sulfur, so it is not a two-element N/P/K fertilizer. Heading 3102 covers mineral or chemical fertilizers, nitrogenous, and 3102.90 covers other, including mixtures not elsewhere specified.

Ammonium thiosulfate is a single chemical compound, so heading 3102 could apply if it is regarded as a nitrogenous fertilizer. Note 2 to Chapter 31 lists the products that fall within 3102, which are ammonium nitrate, ammonium sulfate, and so on, and ammonium thiosulfate is not among them. Note 1 excludes separate chemically defined compounds other than those described in the Chapter 31 notes. Thiosulfates fall under 2832 (sulfites; thiosulfates), and ammonium thiosulfate would be 2832.30 (thiosulfates). However, the packaging is 1-liter containers, which is less than 10 kg, and Note 3 to Chapter 31 covers goods in tablets or similar forms or in packages of a gross weight not exceeding 10 kg. Under Note 1(b), that packaging is excluded from heading 3102 only for goods described in 3102, 3103, 3104 and 3105 that are in packs over 10 kg. Because Note 1 excludes only the chemically defined compounds not in the listed headings, a package under 10 kg makes it fit the Chapter 31 packaging rule, and the product is therefore classified in 3105.90 (other fertilizers). The nitrogen-sulfur combination in a package under 10 kg points to 3105.90.0050 (other).

Note that the 1-liter container at a density of 1.35 g/mL is about 1.35 kg, which is under 10 kg.
